subject: SF
name: South France — village in pen and light wash

styleSelection.reason: Requested pen plus light wash: selective black structural drawing, transparent local colors, one dry shadow glaze, open stone lights.

families.referenceCue: Pale warm stone and ochre roofs above olive trees; fine junctions in ink.
Focal cluster of ochre pitched roofs, cream lit facades, violet-grey side walls, small dark windows.
Broad pale yellow stone terraces and small retaining walls, with irregular foliage interruptions.
Tall dark green vertical forms contrast with broad pale terraces; edges crisp but broken.
Connected olive and sap-green crowns, warm lit tops and cool shadow groups.
Open yellow-green pine crown, narrow dark trunk and spreading irregular branches.
Pale winding paths and loosely linked olive shrubs, darker only under the crowns.
Small cool subdued hillside planes behind the village; no separate leaf details.
